name: update-event
description: Updates an event in Google Calendar. list-events supplies the required eventId; list-calendars supplies IDs for calendars other than primary. Optionally preserves and merges attendees and controls update notifications.

eventId.description: Google Calendar event ID supplied by list-events.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID supplied by list-calendars, or omit to use the primary calendar.

start.description: New start as an RFC 3339 date-time, or YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event.

end.description: New end as an RFC 3339 date-time, or YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone applied to whichever of start and end are supplied.

addAttendees.description: Email addresses to add while preserving existing attendees.

removeAttendees.description: Email addresses to remove while preserving other attendees.

sendUpdates.description: Which guests receive notifications about the update.
